name: BoxLite
description: Embeds hardware-isolated micro-VM sandboxes that run any OCI image with persistent state, via Python, Node, Go, and Rust SDKs, a CLI, or a REST server, for developers running agent code.

skills.name: Isolated Code Execution
skills.description: Runs commands in a per-box hardware-virtualized VM with streamed stdout and stderr, PTY support, and timeouts.

skills.name: Persistent Boxes
skills.description: Keeps box disks and installed packages across stop and restart, with clone and export or import as archives.

skills.name: Egress Control and Secret Injection
skills.description: Restricts outbound network with an allow-list and injects secrets through placeholders that never enter the box.

skills.name: REST Server Mode
skills.description: Serves boxes over a REST API with WebSocket exec and optional API-key auth via `boxlite serve`.
